sources.quote: 8.4.2.1 A change of subcontracted process, including surface treatment, needs notification to Stellantis and approval before shipment.
Annex A: programs STL-Torino-27 and STL-Torino-31.
BOM-LINE 120: part BR-220 (drawing Rev C); program STL-Torino-27; customer STL; material EN AW-6082-T6; features: 4 fastener holes
Surface treatment (subcontracted to Anodica Veneta S.r.l.)

findings.why: BR-220 belongs to program STL-Torino-27 for Stellantis. The in-force control plan names Anodica Veneta as the subcontracted anodiser. Moving the anodising to Rivestimenti Nord is a change of subcontracted surface-treatment process. CSR 8.4.2.1 requires notification to and approval from Stellantis before shipment. No document in force contains such an approval or notification. The 3 lots may not ship until Stellantis has approved the change.
